routes: /alerts (actual OverviewTab/cards/state/API/toast consumer under the offline alert-action-confirmation fixture)
states: All four single-alert actions: explicit rejection, missing marker, contradictory error or wrong snooze expiry enters unconfirmed feedback without retained state change or success.
Snooze keeps the same pending dialog node through an ordinary observation resample and rollback; controls become usable after rejection.
Modal Cancel and explicit view reload precede the next chosen action. Affirmative action advances only its canonical target; critical incidents remain critical.
English, German and Spanish feedback; desktop light and narrow dark touch.
interactions: Desktop keyboard Enter and 320px WebKit touch activate actual acknowledgement/restore/snooze/resume controls.
A second click on each disabled pending control sends no extra write. No rejected response causes an automatic write.
For each snooze, compute the exact expected one-hour instant from the paused page clock before interaction, then require request and accepted state to match.
Reject first response, inspect unchanged/rolled-back target and same-name neighbour, cancel modal if present, explicitly reload, then choose one confirmed action.
